name: Belt Finance beltBUSD Ellipsis LP mispricing
summary: StrategyEllipsisImpl.eps3ToWant() valued the strategy's 3EPS stake as its share of the raw sum of BUSD, USDC and USDT balances in the Ellipsis pool, a spot quantity any swap moves. beltBUSD minted and redeemed shares against that value, so cycling deposit, Ellipsis exchange and withdraw in one transaction drained BUSD from the Venus strategy.
notes: Both proxies were last upgraded before the exploit (StrategyEllipsis at block 6952957, beltBUSD at 6637440); later strategy deposits only read eps3ToWant through staticcalls, which is why campaign.mjs misses the seven follow-up transactions.

Loss is the drop in beltBUSD's own pool value between blocks 7838861 and 7839266 (price per share 1.0185 to 0.8022), net of shares other users redeemed in that window. The attacker kept 6,234,753 BUSD; the rest went to Ellipsis imbalance and flash-loan fees and still counts.
BUSD at par. Belt's later compensation is a recovery and is not subtracted.
